name: DOSBox Pure Unleashed
description:
DOSBox Pure Unleashed is a standalone packaging of DOSBox Pure, a reimagined DOS emulator tailored specifically for gaming. It removes the friction of configuring vintage DOS games with automatic hardware setup, controller mapping, and ZIP launching.

Features:
- Directly load DOS games packaged inside ZIP or 7z archives without manual extraction
- Automatic detection of sound cards, CPU cycles, and display configurations
- Built-in game controller support with automatic key mapping and onscreen keyboard
- Save state support and rewind functionality for vintage gameplay
- Multiple CRT and video enhancement shaders for authentic vintage visuals
